answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a bond twice its 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs, losing weight each epoch unless honest work renews it. A saffron merchant keeps one bond alive by trades, while an attacker must top up every fake bond. Faking 100 identities costs 100,000 units, far above one reward. An honest agent pays once, its ivory certificate renewed by a violet stamp, so rewards stay undiluted.
